layouts.name: Fuglau
layouts.description: The supplied configuration retains the full eastern course and both western returns. The organizer explicitly identifies its morning inner-return and afternoon outer-return configurations. These paved paths are independently digitized from the 2024 basemap.at orthophoto. The northern gravel spur, central shortcut, eastern inner loop and paddock access are excluded. This network measures unique branches rather than one timed lap; historical direction and fine alignment remain draft. Independently digitized aerial branch network: 1337.0 m. Shared edges count once; this configuration set is not a single lap, and no line joins separate paths. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
